overview:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: VR game furniture concept for review, NOT an in-game screenshot.
Create a polished, believable 3D concept render of a compact travelling merchant station in a Gloomhaven-style forest clearing. Use the attached screenshot ONLY as a reference for the existing bald bearded merchant's red cape, ochre clothing, woodland ambience and human scale. REDESIGN the furniture completely.
Main design: a freestanding upright wooden merchandise cabinet BESIDE the merchant, never below a desk and never blocking his body. Cabinet approximately 1.65 metres tall, 0.85 metres wide, 0.45 metres deep, visible sturdy transport handles, iron corner bands, worn crafted hardwood, practical fold-out feet. It is a portable trader's cabinet, not a gigantic wardrobe, kiosk or vending machine. Front contains twelve individually grabbable LANDSCAPE-format fantasy item cards on three rows of four small discrete mechanical holders. All cards are already present and face the approaching player at approximately waist to chest height. No cards near floor or overhead. Six large tactile brass-and-wood category buttons with simple engraved pictograms (helmet, armour, boots, one hand, two hands, pouch) along the front at comfortable reach. A clearly reachable real hand crank on the side at waist height, for changing the page. Card holders travel inward into the cabinet on concealed sliding tracks; this render shows them fully extended and accessible.
Merchant stands visibly NEXT to this cabinet with only a SMALL separate folding writing lectern for a ledger, coins and scale. One warm practical lantern on cabinet bracket, physically coherent gentle light, readable subject, existing dark woods in background, no overbright glow. Place furniture on ground; realistic scale and proportions; no huge table, no large horizontal structures, no drawers as interaction, no floating windows, no digital UI, no signs with made-up words. Craft detail and believable construction, no overornamentation.
Wide eye-level three-quarter view includes entire cabinet, merchant, small ledger stand and feet, with sufficient ambient fill to judge construction. One beautiful single full-bleed concept image, no panel collage, no title or watermark.
changeover:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: furniture interaction concept sheet for VR game review, not executable UI.
Use the supplied concept as the exact visual design reference for the upright travelling card cabinet next to a merchant. Create a clear attractive landscape presentation sheet on a quiet neutral parchment-grey background with THREE evenly spaced three-quarter views of the SAME cabinet, showing how the cards change. No merchant needed in this diagram. Preserve compact upright proportions, twelve LANDSCAPE rectangular card holders in three rows of four, six physical engraved brass category pushbuttons along the lower front and a real hand crank on the side.
LEFT panel: cabinet open for browsing, twelve original-style fantasy ITEM CARDS fully visible with little illustration plus tiny unreadable rules text, individually graspable, all at standing waist/chest height, not giant icon-only category tiles. Caption exactly '1 · Auswählen'.
MIDDLE panel: a subtle illustrative cutaway of the cabinet's side reveals the same rigid card-holder cassette sliding BACKWARD horizontally into a dark interior behind a narrow wooden shutter, its cards remaining mounted. Small unobtrusive arrows show the inward movement. Caption exactly '2 · Einfahren'.
RIGHT panel: a replacement cassette with different item artwork gliding OUT from the same aperture to the exact same browsing position, with subtle outward arrows. Caption exactly '3 · Ausfahren'.
The mechanism is a compact internal indexed card cassette system; the category press or side crank initiates the same smooth withdraw–index–extend motion. No cards teleport in front of the player, no rotation of a big rack. All three panels consistent: same frame, same six buttons, same crank, same card proportions; only the cassette position changes. Visualize feasible short rails and an opaque changeover zone. Craft believable worn wood, iron hardware, leather straps, warm brass, soft neutral studio lighting that shows mechanism without dramatic shadows. Distinguish cutaway only in middle panel. This is an explainer concept, not construction-certified CAD. No extra labels, no page numbers, no digital screens, no floating UI, no waterfall of cards, no cards below knees. Clean professional game prop concept art.
